dodging.label: slips
dodging.note: evasion sequence: bobs, slips and leans, guard low, drifts 0.5 m back; cut single slips / a duck out of it

bodyhook2.label: body lead hook
bodyhook2.note: lead hook to the body with a small step in (wide arc, f30-65); arc too sideways for the reach detector

floored.label: down
floored.note: lying on the canvas, small breathing / stirring; loops; no get-up in it

knockdown1.note: folds forward from a body shot, drops to the knees, rolls onto the back; settles about f110

knockdown2.note: stumbles forward 1.2 m and falls face down

knockdown3.note: crumples straight down on the spot, ends on the back

knockdown4.note: blown backwards from guard by a big head shot, flat on the back

knockdown5.note: spun and dropped forward from guard

knockdown6.note: slow sink to the knees, then falls forward; long (3.9 s)

dizzy_idle.label: stagger (dizzy idle)
dizzy_idle.note: stunned, wobbling idle (by name; stats show head drifting 0.23 m, no punches)

dodging_copy.label: slips
dodging_copy.note: from a long guard (lead arm out), one deep slip / duck to his right at f30-60, back up; in place

entry.label: entry (walk in)
entry.note: walks in from standing 2.5 m and settles into guard; not a fight move

head_hit_1.label: hit head medium
head_hit_1.note: head snaps back, lead arm flung wide (no punch)

head_hit_copy.label: hit head light
head_hit_copy.note: small head knock, guard stays up

light_hit_to_head_1.label: hit head light
light_hit_to_head_1.note: very small knock (head 9 cm); the subtlest hit clip

medium_hit_to_head.label: hit head medium
medium_hit_to_head.note: named medium; measures heavy (head 0.45 m back+down)

hook.label: lead hook
hook.note: lead hook with a step in (f10-60); path too sideways for the reach detector

idle_1.label: fight idle (long guard)
idle_1.note: guard with the lead arm extended (long guard), barely moves

receive_stomach_uppercut.label: hit uppercut (body)
receive_stomach_uppercut.note: doubles over from a body uppercut, arms flail (no punch)

receiving_a_big_uppercut.label: hit uppercut heavy (staggers back)
receiving_a_big_uppercut.note: rocked by an uppercut, arms fly up, staggers 1.5 m back then re-guards; also the best stagger

receiving_an_uppercut.label: hit uppercut (staggers back)
receiving_an_uppercut.note: rocked, steps 1.1 m back then re-guards

defeat.label: lose
defeat.note: standing, arms down, dejected; not in stance

victory.label: win
victory.note: arms raised celebration; not in stance

taunt.label: taunt
taunt.note: showboat gesture from guard (arm swings that look like uppercuts)

warming_up.label: warm-up (shadowboxing)
warming_up.note: loose shadowboxing out of stance; not a fight move

boxing_3.note: rear uppercut with a step in, lands low (chest / body height)
